description: In recent years, alongside Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) import initiatives, the Government of Bangladesh (GoB) has placed strong emphasis on maximizing the production and utilization of indigenous natural gas resources to ensure long-term energy security and reduce dependency on imported fuels. In this context, Bangladesh Petroleum Exploration and Production Company Limited (BAPEX), under the guidance of Petrobangla, has been implementing various onshore and offshore exploration and development programs aimed at enhancing domestic gas supply. One of the notable outcomes of these initiatives is the discovery and subsequent development of Zakiganj Gas Field. The Zakiganj Gas Field was discovered in 2021 in the Zakiganj Gas Field area and has since been identified as a significant contributor to the national gas resource base. According to BAPEX estimates, the Gas Initially in Place (GIIP) of the Zakiganj Gas Field-1 is approximately 50 billion cubic feet (BCF), while the recoverable gas reserve is estimated at about 37 BCF. BAPEX has projected the probable daily production capacity of the Zakiganj Gas Field well at 10 MMscfd. Furthermore, BAPEX has forecasted long-term gas production from the Zakiganj Gas Field at a rate of approximately 10 MMscfd about eight years. In parallel, Gas Transmission Company Limited (GTCL) has undertaken the construction of a gas transmission pipeline from Zakiganj Gas Field to Koilashtila/Beanibazar.
